correctness.rationale: The single-element binomial identity reduces the word to I+N^p, and p strictly increasing jumps leave exactly six possible output positions. The three products on displacement p force αγ=0 when β=0; when β is nonzero and both outer products vanish, the two exterior a entries are zero. Surviving paths must skip each missing exterior edge, giving the stated determinantal constraint βζ=δε. In the β≠0 constructions the selected length-three jump c_1 or c_p changes ζ with coefficient γ or α without changing the other coordinates. With β=0 and one outer product nonzero, the only selected b jumps are adjacent and cannot coexist on a path, so the designated c corrects ζ independently. With all three products zero and δε≠0, a_3=0 kills each leading product while b_2 and c_2 jump over it, permitted even at p=3. In the remaining cases the two exterior b jumps give exactly δ, ε and ζ through the specified interior products. Hence no field roots beyond division by nonzero scalars are needed, and the finite-field cases sum to the displayed polynomial. The independently written path enumeration at /workspace/branches/f9130bf5-9035-4508-b609-dd1af15a020e/independent_record4.py (output independent_record4.txt) compared all 531441 effective sources over F3 to the full target predicate and found equal 585-element images. This corroborates one bounded case, not the quantifier over arbitrary fields. The frozen prime-field checks were inspected separately.
